reviews.text: A place with great facilities and countless specialties where we were treated kindly.

Terrible service. My dog ​​had a bad reaction to the vaccine, and the doctor kept saying it must be something else, that the medicine wasn't causing anything. I had to go to another vet immediately. Don't waste your time; don't put your pets at risk.

I had a bad experience at this place a while ago. I took my partner's dog in for an emergency (during the day). They saw her and said they would do some blood tests to find out what was wrong. The "doctor" hurt the dog, was never able to draw blood, and told me that the problem was my dog, that I should come back when she was calmer, and that I should bring her back later the next day when the other "doctor" was there. She told me not to worry because she seemed stable, and that I could bring her back the next day if I wanted. My dog ​​died that night. I can't stop wondering if the doctor who had been able to examine her would still be here, or maybe not, but I think that at this clinic they are neither trained nor do they have the "tact or humanity."

I used to take my dog ​​there and he was well cared for; I even recommended it to friends. But the last time I went, I only paid for one consultation, only to be told they couldn't help us, and I received an inappropriate comment from the veterinarian, Miriam García. She referred me to a hospital very far away when it was clearly an emergency, knowing there's another specialty hospital nearby.
They encourage people to keep "exotic" animals, disgusting.

The doctors are excellent, very professional. The doctor there provides wonderful care; they are very warm and kind. My little one was hospitalized, and when I went to pick her up, she was stable and happy. Quesadilla thanks you!

Excellent service, very professional, and wonderful people. They were attentive to my cat at all times. We went for an endoscopy, and from the moment they answered the phone, they were incredibly kind—a stark contrast to other hospitals that were extremely uncooperative. As for the price, without a doubt, they are the best for a highly specialized procedure. ♥️♥️♥️
Terrible service. Instead of examining my cat, they gave me a quote of 6,500. Don't take your pets.

A few years ago, I had a terrible experience at this clinic. My dog ​​was scheduled for surgery at 8 AM, and by the afternoon, they were saying there were delays but that she would be in surgery soon. 7 PM came and went, and they never answered or contacted me again until 9 PM when I had to go to Petco. They had barely taken my dog ​​into surgery. I had an argument with the owner about the situation, and five minutes later, she conveniently "died during surgery." To make matters worse, another man was also complaining that he had been there for an hour with his dog, who had been hit by a car, and they hadn't attended to her. He witnessed and confirmed that my calls had been ignored. If you love your pets, NEVER take them to this place.

Today I called because I had an emergency with my puppy. The person who answered, despite my explaining that it was an emergency and their ad stating 24-hour emergency service, told me they couldn't see my dog ​​until I made an appointment, which they said would be available after 3:00 pm.
Honestly, this place is terrible!
They should remove the "24-hour emergency" claim from their ad because it's clearly a lie.
Besides, their attitude is awful.
Disgusting.
We went to the emergency room because my turtle had fallen and the service was very good.

Dr. Stephanie is a sweetheart.
I took my kitten in for a respiratory emergency, and she received extraordinary care. The entire on-call team was incredibly kind, and their love for their work and patients was evident. I thought it would be very expensive, but it wasn't. Everything was excellent. 10/10 service ❤️🫂🐈‍⬛
Dr. Hector made me feel bad and didn't give me any reports about what my dog ​​suffered during his stay.

The doctors at this clinic provide wonderful care. I've taken at least three of my pets there over time, one even as an emergency at night, and they were all treated very well. They truly care about the dogs' well-being.
Dr. Martha found us a dog to adopt, and he's been with us for almost two years now, and we love him very much. Thank you!
Excellent service. Thank you so much! Quality and warmth

I'm so grateful that Dr. Silvia, the veterinarian, saw my French bulldog for an emergency visit on Sunday, June 7th at 8:00 AM. The treatment she gave her immediately and the medication she sent home was exactly right. My dog ​​had been vomiting and had bloody diarrhea all night, so I was terrified she'd get dehydrated. I called and they said they could see her, so I didn't hesitate to go despite the reviews I'd read on Google Maps. They were incredibly kind and treated her wonderfully. My dog ​​left the vet's office as if nothing had happened. Later, when I got home, I saw her lethargic and vomiting again, so I went back. They told me the best thing to do was hospitalize her, but I refused. I just put my hopes in the treatment and patience for her recovery... and she did so well! The next day she was much better, and now my baby is as good as new. Thank you for the recommendations, for taking care of her, and for the love Silvia had for my baby.

Last night, my kitten swallowed a needle. I arrived with the x-ray around 2 am. They acted wonderfully, gave her the necessary care, and managed to save her. I'm so grateful and highly recommend them.

We took my dog ​​to the emergency vet. During the shift change, the second veterinarian gave a different diagnosis than the first two. They charged exorbitant fees for procedures we didn't witness, including 25 catheters (1,000 pesos) for the four hours my dog ​​was there. They claimed they used so many because they couldn't find her veins, but I felt they were incompetent. My impression is that they're only interested in making money. We know it's a business, but you go in expecting them to be ethical. I left feeling ripped off. They charged me over 4,000 pesos for no surgical procedure, just medications they supposedly used that I didn't see. I would never recommend them.
Terrible doctors at night, inhumane and more concerned with the bill. If you have the chance to go, don't.

Be very careful with this business; it's staffed by inexperienced and terrible veterinarians. My dog ​​went in for dehydration and died within a day and a half. They have an agreement with Sta Dogs, which recommends sending your pets there. Think twice before leaving your pets there.
They saved my dog's life and followed up on him.

Excellent service and attention.
The doctors were very professional and attentive.
Especially Dr. Elihu David, who treated me.
Accessible, we went for a consultation with the ophthalmologist, very professional, excellent service

They helped us with an emergency. The doctors who treated us were very kind.
Our dog is doing great after the treatment they gave her.
They clearly have extensive knowledge and explain the situation very well.

Excellent care with top-notch specialists. No one wanted to operate on my little Pug with a giant tumor, but they operated on her immediately because they said, "This girl can't suffer any longer." Everything went wonderfully. Thank you, Dr. Raquel, Dr. Mejia (anesthesiologist), Dr. Guevara (surgeon), and Jorge, the accompanying staff member. Everyone was incredibly kind and compassionate. I'm missing some names, but the cardiologist and the oncologist were also outstanding. Everyone!
Excellent service.
Personally, my pets have received excellent care. The veterinarians are very professional and also very compassionate. I recommend them 100%, and the best part is that they make house calls.
Well, I personally took my two dogs there after they tested positive for parvovirus, and the care was so good that they saved the lives of my two babies.
Excellent, very professional service.

I am eternally grateful to the staff at this hospital. I took my dog ​​there at 1 a.m., she had emergency surgery for pyometra, and they saved her life. After the surgery, the doctor told us that her uterus had already perforated due to the pus and that if we had brought her in the next morning, she probably wouldn't have survived. The staff is exceptional, professional, and very empathetic.

I would recommend this hospital a thousand times over because my dog's case was very complicated, and if she's with me today, it's thanks to them.

I think some of the reviews mentioned the wrong place because they talk a lot about the prices, but I went there precisely because emergency pyometra surgery was much more expensive elsewhere, and I was pleasantly surprised to find that you don't need the most expensive place to get excellent service. Personally, they gave me the best possible treatment and were with me every step of the way. Thank you so much ❤️
Excellent care and efficient service from Dr. Óscar Gutiérrez, great Orthopedics service.

February 14, 2026.
I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet because she had been hit by a car. She walked with difficulty and even barked before being examined. She was whimpering from her injuries. Medication after medication. The result: they returned her to me dead in a body bag.
Terrible experience. My cat was admitted to the hospital and 2 hours later they returned him to me dead.

My dog ​​arrived with pyometra and was in very bad shape. They operated on her and saved her. Dr. Cristian treated her in the emergency room and was incredibly attentive, constantly monitoring Mia's progress even after she had left the hospital. Excellent service.

About six months ago, my son took my very sick cat to the vet. They "examined" her and admitted her. The next morning, they called to say she was better and eating, but the following day they called to say she was dying and there was nothing more they could do. 😭 My son went to the vet and, sure enough, she was already dying. 😭 They let her die and didn't tell us what was wrong with her because the test results weren't delivered until a week after she had already passed away. They charged us about 15,000 pesos for two days and a night, and it took them almost a week to deliver her ashes. I called to request them, and they told me they didn't have them yet. I told them it was a long time, and the guy angrily replied that if I wanted, I could pick up the body and take it somewhere else. They're not good there anymore. About 15 years ago, they were good; now it's just interns, or at least that's what they seem to be.
Terrible service
It's an excellent place for pet care. I've been taking my dogs there for years and will continue to do so.

Incredible care from the doctors and all the hospital staff. I arrived with my dog ​​in an emergency at night and they attended to her quickly. They performed the necessary tests so they could take her into surgery immediately and save her life. God bless them always 🙏 …

Yesterday, around 2:00 a.m., while I was with my partner, one of my kittens, a two-month-old, started showing serious symptoms: she was on the floor convulsing, having difficulty breathing, making spasm-like sounds, barely able to move, and at times completely unresponsive.

Given the urgency, I looked for a 24-hour veterinary clinic and found this place. I called, explained the situation in detail, and they told me to bring her in, asking me to confirm.

In a second call, I confirmed that I was already on my way. They asked me again if I would be there and how long it would take; I told them that Google Maps said it would be 11 minutes and confirmed that I was already on my way. They said that was fine.
When I arrived, I called to let them know I was outside, but they refused to see us. They informed me that they had another emergency and that the wait would be approximately 30 minutes. I reiterated that it was an emergency, as my kitten was still breathing and whimpering, but couldn't move. Even so, they wouldn't open the door and simply told me that if I wanted, I could wait or find another place.

I was forced to leave immediately to look for another option. The next vet did see her, but unfortunately, it was too late. I lost valuable time, and they couldn't revive her or give her any chance.

If they had informed me from the beginning that they couldn't treat her, I would have looked for another option without wasting those crucial minutes. I'm posting this review so that others know that, although they advertise themselves as a 24-hour emergency service, they don't guarantee immediate attention, even in critical situations.

Terrible veterinary care. A misdiagnosis in the emergency room by Dr. Luis Antonio Guevara Salas cost my dog ​​his life.
Most of the reviews are similar and have equally terrible outcomes. Be very careful with your pets.
Cheer up !!
They've taken excellent care of my dogs. Dr. Elena is an amazing cardiologist who has kept one of my dogs stable.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS HOSPITAL
Reading all the reviews, I see why they have such bad comments.
Unfortunately, we ended up here because a vet sent us for some tests, and my dog ​​was hospitalized. It's true that they only see patients as MONEY.
I know my dog ​​arrived sick, but I completely regret that he spent his last days here. The day after he was admitted, I saw him in very bad shape. He barely wanted to walk and was very dehydrated, even though he was on an IV. When I told them this, they said it was normal, so I left him there for another night. The next day, I went to pick him up, and he couldn't even stand. He was on the floor, injured and bleeding from his little arms because they keep them in a cage without putting anything soft underneath them, even though my dog ​​couldn't stand up. They still told me they recommended he stay with them longer, and of course, we refused and took him home. He couldn't even pant anymore because his mouth was completely dry, and his tongue was stuck to the roof of his mouth and sticking out. He didn't last even an hour and died in my arms; at least he was with us in his final moments.
Not to mention it cost over 15,000 pesos for two nights, when another place I'd stayed before had charged less than 2,000 pesos for two nights.
IF YOU LOVE YOUR PETS, DON'T BRING THEM HERE. You have no idea how much I regret trusting them.

I called to ask if they could see my dog… and the woman who answered said she didn't know… because they'd be going into a procedure… I understand that… I'm a surgeon… but I called precisely so I wouldn't make a wasted trip… and she said… well, if she arrives and we're not here, someone else will send her to another branch… so it's better if she tells me right away… so we don't waste time… if it were an EMERGENCY… which fortunately isn't the case with my dog… her answers don't help in making crucial decisions to save a dog's life… I told her… I'll be there in 15-20 minutes maximum while I travel… and she says… that she doesn't know…
Good 24-hour service
The doctors are always very kind, and Titan, Taquito, and Molly love Dr. Luis Guevara; he saved them!
Excellent service, the doctor is very attentive and provides excellent care.
It's a bit pricey, but Dr. Raquel's care is excellent. She saved my schnauzer's life from pyometra, and later treated my Yorkie. So when I go, I try to get her to treat me.

The care and patience with which they treat patients is unlike anything you'll find anywhere else. They are truly committed to the health of our beloved furry friends, whom we see not as pets but as members of the family.
They are excellent!!!! 100% recommended
Excellent professional service

It was a TERRIBLE experience!!! If you don't want your pets to die, avoid taking them here.

They make a huge mess of EVERYTHING! They charge you for everything, even breathing, and they give you incredibly exaggerated diagnoses. They're not professional; they see the animals as a product.

I read a comment below that also describes my experience, although my mistake was leaving my little one there, without imagining that the next day they would return him to me in a black bag. I didn't want to have him cremated there, because even in my grief, they were charging me almost 3 TIMES MORE than the place I took him to.

A veterinarian implied that nowadays, animals are considered almost like children, and this was an opportunity to take advantage of them.

On August 20th, I took my dog ​​to the vet for an eye exam. To begin with, when we arrived, they didn't want to see us because, supposedly, we didn't have an appointment. She was seen by a woman claiming to be Dr. Raquel María Elena Suárez Gómez. My dog ​​had an eye infection, and they diagnosed her with pyometra simply because we told them she was eight years old and not spayed. The doctor started asking absurd questions, as if trying to guess her condition. They took her upstairs for a so-called ultrasound, and the doctor there kept saying that "maybe it was her bladder they saw." They didn't even know how to read an ultrasound. The "hospital" was dirty and disorganized. After the ultrasound, they tried to scare us, saying it was urgent to operate on my dog ​​because she was going to die and they had to operate right then and there. Fortunately, we are very suspicious and observant, so we didn't fall for it. We took our dog to another hospital nearby where they are actually professional and gave her the care she needed. These people only see animals as products and lie to get money from you by exploiting your concern for your pet. DO NOT take your pets to this place.

I took my dog ​​in for poisoning, and Dr. Esther was very professional and patient, since my puppy is very temperamental and made a mess in the office. Haha. Thank God she's much better now. Thank you so much!
Incredible service, they gave my baby a second chance
Professional care and personalized follow-up for pets; in my case, a bunny who responded very well to the treatment. I recommend them, as they can come to your home. 🐇 …

I have been attending with my two old dogs for more than 2 years and they have always been treated and diagnosed very well, thanks to Dr. Hector who has made the life of my little ones longer and of higher quality.
Thank you for the great empathy and treatment you showed my incredible Chapo.

I've been taking my dog ​​to this clinic for about two years now, for preventative blood tests, vaccinations, and most recently for gastroenteritis. I've found every single veterinarian who has treated my dog ​​to be incredibly …

Almost 24-hour service
Good prices, considering they mostly handle emergency consultations
I haven't tried the grooming service, but they have dogs in the back, perhaps from the boarding or hospitalization area
Always professional, Dr. Raquel is very accurate and loves dogs. Thank you for everything!!!

A very good hospital. The care from veterinarian Mireya was excellent. They stabilized my dog ​​and helped her with problems stemming from an insulin deficiency. She was hospitalized for several days, and they provided us with clear …

The service is excellent, and the veterinarians are attentive, kind, and very experienced. My dog ​​had bladder inflammation, and the treatment has been perfect. We take all our family pets there; highly recommended.
Terrible place, they're only interested in money. My dog ​​suffered terribly while hospitalized in this awful place. If I could give it zero stars, I would.

I absolutely do not recommend this establishment. I called to request information and schedule a study for my pet, and to even book an appointment, they demanded 100% payment upfront. Don't be fooled by their attractive website.

If I could give it zero stars, I would.
We went to this "hospital" for an emergency with my kitten, a huge mistake.
The prescription they give you lists many "veterinarians," so I don't know …
Excellent care for our Lucy; we found the perfect place to ensure our kitten is always well looked after.
The worst.
